1.consolidated_definition: Bolsa de tela liviana rellena de una fibra suave, generalmente semillas de guano, que son como algodón y se usan como almohadas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Lightweight fabric pouch filled with a soft fiber, typically guano seed down, similar to cotton, used as pillows.
